items.title: Conjari- Escape from Sequoia Archives
items.summary: Cast out by tragedy, a former heiress and her guard become outlaws in a world of centauric folk, striving to mend fractured factions and restore the unison they once knew, piece by piece.In this scene our young ex-heiress, Lula, escapes Sequoia Archives with a powerful artifact, not realizing a former friend she once considered a brother is after the same thing…
